title: Mazdoor
desc: Dinanath is a foreman in a textile mill who dreams of one day running his own mill more fairly. He leaves the mill after upsetting the management by supporting his mistreated co-workers. With the support and inspiration of a young orphan, Ashok, he has taken in, Dinanath raises the money to buy a property, leading to the eventual realization of his dream. Then Smita enters the picture and everything starts to go wrong.

title: Ittefaq
desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.

title: Nikaah
desc: A young and attractive woman is swept off her feet by a foreign businessman, and the pair marries. However, when the man begins dedicating himself more and more to his work, things go wrong.

title: Budkaar
desc: Mini, a young woman, is kidnapped from a pub and police investigate the case. However, when her sister sets out to find her, she uncovers a criminal nexus which shakes the city.

title: Phool Aur Angaar
desc: A young man rescues a woman from being molested but gets accused of the heinous crime instead. Trying to apprehend the miscreants, he gets caught in a web of deception and lies.
